_comment: LoopStar phrase-pack meta for CLASSICAL-AS-LOOPS (Phase ML.4 -- the public-domain cluster). Schema: phrases/SPEC.md. Encoded from docs/idiom-research/genre-jazz-blues-classical.md GENRE 3. GM programs are 0-based (source-book is 1-based: 41 Violin -> 40, 74 Flute -> 73, 69 Oboe -> 68, 43 Cello -> 42, 44 Contrabass -> 43, 48 Timpani -> 47, 1 Piano -> 0, 49 String Ensemble -> 48, 7 Harpsichord -> 6). Classical is ALWAYS straight: every phrase sets swingSensitive false. Registers follow the source-book section 5: lead C5-C7 (72-96) for violin/flute, kept clear of the C2-G3 cello/continuo window so the melody stays the required two octaves above the bass -- a lead floor down at C4 collided with the ostinato and read as inner-voice mush. RULE #1: content, zero-rebuild.
_legal: This is the one pack where famous melodies are encoded VERBATIM: every pdSource work was PUBLISHED 1930 or earlier and is US public domain as of 2026. Degrees/roles are encoded from the composition, never from a modern engraved edition's layout, and never from a sound recording. Phrases carrying provenance.inspiration are original-in-idiom realizations of freely copyable archetypes (rhythm grids, ground-bass constructions, voicing techniques).
